name: dvstack
description: Skills and working examples for front-end work and test automation, collected from real projects.

plugins.name: dvstack-frontend
plugins.description: Front-end skills that ship with working source files: the agent copies proven code into your project instead of rewriting it from scratch.

plugins.name: dvstack-testing
plugins.description: Playwright end-to-end skills: naming conventions, suite architecture, test strategy, fixtures, locators, API-driven setup, network mocking, hard interactions, accessibility, visual testing, debugging, flaky-test triage, CI sharding, and a code-review checklist.
